title: CA CPI first-print revision-sign late-window drift (restricted v1->v2 vintage-gap sign, PIT at v2 availability day, USDCAD, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage, count and the census's descriptive magnitude quartiles from the pinned P0 restricted census/gate were consumed (no threshold pass-rate was measured).

mechanism.story: A first-print restricted revision event is the statistical agency itself correcting the measured CA inflation path for month m: v2 moves the published index vs the first print. Revisions are obscure information: they arrive with date-only evidence in the realtime archive, carry no headline, no press cycle and no consensus, and their availability is provable only through vintage windows. Beliefs anchored on the first print decay slowly; every derived calculation that consumes month m (YoY paths, trend estimates, seasonals) silently changes underneath stale-belief agents. The hypothesis is that the revision SIGN sets a slow drift on USDCAD that survives the PIT-provable late entry plus the holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) stale-belief adaptive agents who never re-read a non-headline vintage correction; (ii) benchmark/tracking books and calendar-fixing corporate hedgers who rebalance on scheduled windows after the revised path propagates into their inputs; (iii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: the revision value's availability evidence is date-only (FRED/ALFRED realtime_start), the conservative availability bound is end-of-day UTC on the v2 vintage day, and entry is the first 16:00-NY grid instant strictly after -- necessarily after the vintage pull, months after the original print. The hypothesis is that revision repricing survives that PIT-provable lag plus the horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_it_might_exist: Distinct information object from every dead ancestor: the ng1 A4 class conditioned on the FIRST PRINT vs a naive predictor (print-vs-expectation deviation); V6/V7 conditioned on the sign of the scheduled release. THIS lane conditions on the agency's own v1->v2 correction -- information that exists only on the vintaged archive, is never a headline, and therefore plausibly prices slowly. The census proves the stream is alive (72 CA first-print restricted events, 17 in the recent 24 months) and free of the bulk re-referencing artifact by construction (restriction law).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0) if the revision sign is priced by the time the v2 vintage is provably observable. It must die by falsification if the identical book is reproduced by a nominal-yield-level exposure (CTL-DGS10LEVEL, the exact control that killed FXNG1-A4-P2 as cluster #15), by a constant-direction clock shadow (Q-7), or by the same stale signs placed on non-revision vintage dates (placebo). It dies at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full failure inventory including the FXNG1-A4-P2 books and the V8/V9 shadows (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: the CA first-print RESTRICTED revision stream built by research/assets/forex_ng3/revision_series.py (build_restricted_stream) on the pinned vintaged CANCPIALLMINMEI archive; NO consensus/forecast data anywhere; NO later-vintage (v3+) reads anywhere; NO cross-economy conditioning (own-economy lane).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.prior: the first print itself: I_v1(m), the value as first carried by the earliest realtime vintage publishing m. No separate predictor is constructed -- the naive prior IS the first print, and the revision is the correction of that prior.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.surprise: R(e) = I_v2(m) / I_v1(m) - 1 (fraction), the ng2-frozen revision-event semantics inherited via import; e is a restricted event (first_print_in_realtime_era=True, no bulk re-referencing group membership, v2 availability day inside the S0 window).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.i_v1_i_v2_source: values read strictly within their own realtime windows (the vintage in force for each leg); never a later vintage, never a current-vintage table (v9_high_finding_binding).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.pit_rule: R(e) is knowable only at A(e) = 23:59:59Z on v2.realtime_start (date-only evidence, conservative end-of-day bound). Decision day D(e) = first 16:00-NY grid instant strictly AFTER A(e); a same-day 16:00-NY decision NEVER sees a vintage whose availability bound is that same date (16:00-NY = 20:00Z/21:00Z < 23:59:59Z). The frozen validator refuses any fill whose conditioning value postdates the decision instant (P-1..P-6 chain; ONE_EVENT_LAG impossible by construction).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.stream_integrity_policy: STRICT vintage monotonicity fail-closed (a single violation raises and NOTHING is built); byte-identical duplicate rows deduplicated first; conflicting same-realtime_start rows raise (month unmeasurable, never guessed); bulk re-referencing groups (>= 10 events sharing an identical (v1 day, v2 day, ratio-to-1e-6) signature) excluded by the restricted-stream law.

frozen_parameters.anchor_rule: fire on every restricted event with sign(R) != 0; no magnitude threshold on the anchor (the sign construction conditions on direction, not size)
frozen_parameters.neighbour_parameterization: revision-momentum construction: direction = sign( R(e) + R(e-1) + R(e-2) + R(e-3) ), the sum over the current plus the trailing 3 restricted events ordered by v2 availability day (ties broken by obs_month ascending, deterministic); same H = 5
frozen_parameters.threshold_selection_basis: blind frozen priors chosen before any outcome; no threshold in this proposal was selected using any measured pass rate (none exists); no tuning permitted after any number is seen (P-15)

CA.quoting: USD/CAD, long = long USD vs CAD, therefore long CAD = short USDCAD

universe.anchor_law: plan section 3: CA is the ONLY anchor economy of this cycle (CA->USDCAD); US is the quote leg, measured and disclosed, never anchored; GB/AU/NZ are excluded as anchor and appear only as A5 non-anchor differential legs (not used in this own-economy lane)
universe.direction_law: R < 0 (CA index revised DOWN => CA inflation path lower than first printed => CAD-negative) => LONG USDCAD (short CAD). R > 0 => SHORT USDCAD (long CAD). sign(R) == 0 (float-exact zero ratio, possible only for sub-float64 differences) => no position, disclosed. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias in the rule; the census-disclosed magnitude distribution (max +3.7e-05% vs min -7.979984%) implies the realized book will be predominantly long-USDCAD -- a disclosed one-sided realized polarity that the adversarial clock shadow and the DGS10 control are specifically constructed to catch.
